grammar.label: second conditional
grammar.form: If + past simple, would + base verb
grammar.meaning: an imagined or unlikely present or future situation

explanation.en: Use the past form after 'if' for a situation you are only imagining. The past form here is not past time — it marks distance from reality.
explanation.uz: 'if' dan keyin o'tgan zamon shakli faqat tasavvur qilingan holat uchun ishlatiladi. Bu yerda o'tgan zamon vaqtni emas, haqiqatdan uzoqlikni bildiradi.

grammar.positive_example: If I had more time, I would learn the piano.
grammar.negative_example: If I would have more time, I would learn the piano.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekchada shart qo'shimchasi (-sa) ikkala qismda ham bir xil, shuning uchun 'if' dan keyin 'would' qo'yish xatosi keng tarqalgan.
l1_notes.ru: В русском 'бы' стоит в обеих частях — отсюда 'If I would…'.

grammar.label: first vs second conditional
grammar.form: If + present, will … vs If + past, would …
grammar.meaning: a real possibility against an imagined one

explanation.en: The first conditional says the situation is possible. The second says it is unlikely or unreal. The same sentence can take either, and the choice is the message.
explanation.uz: Birinchi shart — real imkoniyat. Ikkinchi shart — kam ehtimolli yoki xayoliy. Bir xil gapga ikkalasi ham mos kelishi mumkin; tanlov ma'noni belgilaydi.

grammar.positive_example: If it rains, we will stay in. If it snowed in June, I would be amazed.
grammar.negative_example: If it snowed in June, I will be amazed.

phonology.label: Fall-rise for reservation and polite disagreement
Weak forms in fast speech — was, were, been, have, has, had
Polite intonation in requests — wide pitch range

story.title: If it were up to me

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: If you had the choice, would you stay in this city?

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I think it is about the work. If I found a good job, I would stay.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Then I would probably go to Almaty. But that is unlikely.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: As far as I know, there are more openings there.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: That is true, but the cost of living is higher too.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: I see what you mean, but the pay is higher as well.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I would say the difference is smaller than people think.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Fair enough. If I were you, I would apply in both cities.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I am doing that. If something comes up here, I will take it.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: That is sensible. Keeping both doors open costs nothing.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Exactly. A decision now would be too early.
